_comment: Per-route first-load JS in bytes, pinned by `npm run bundle:pin` from the static export in out/ (every /_next JS file a route's own HTML references). Measured with plain `npm run build` (next build, Turbopack, no post-processing step) because that is the artifact the deploy publishes; NEXT_PUBLIC_* differ per environment but only inline short strings. Webpack splits chunks differently, so its numbers are not comparable; _builder records which one these were pinned with and check-bundle-budget.mjs refuses a mismatch. Tolerance 8% (same as ctech-poker) over the pinned value, from a single build at @aoctech/ui 0.9.1. Re-pin deliberately, in the same commit as the change that moved a number, stating the reason.
